UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores a signed-in user's Bangla typing progress, unlocked characters, per-key stats, daily totals, and practice settings.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the Profile view.

email.description: Gmail address of the authenticated user.

topWpm.description: Highest WPM recorded across all lessons.

unlockedChars.description: List of unlocked Bangla characters in the adaptive curriculum.

ignoredChars.description: List of Bangla characters intentionally ignored/skipped by the user in Guided practice.

manualFocusChar.description: Manually pinned focus Bangla character, or empty string.

keyStats.description: Map of Bangla character to cumulative hits, misses, totalTimeMs, recentWpm, and lastPracticedAt.

dailyStats.description: Map of YYYY-MM-DD date string to daily durationMs, lessons, charsTyped, and avgWpm.

settings.description: User layout, target WPM, daily goal, theme, and typing preferences.

freeHandStats.description: Isolated cumulative stats, keyStats, and dailyStats exclusively for Free Hand practice mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

LessonEntry.title: LessonEntry
LessonEntry.description: Immutable record of a single completed Bangla typing practice lesson.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who completed the lesson.

layout.description: Keyboard layout used for the lesson.

mode.description: Practice mode used for the lesson.

charCount.description: Number of target keystrokes in the lesson.

errorCount.description: Number of errors made in the lesson.

focusChar.description: Focus character during the lesson, or empty string.

unlockedChar.description: Newly unlocked Bangla character after this lesson, or empty string.

timestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds when the lesson finished.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lesson document was created.

/users/{userId}.description: Owner-only user profile document storing cumulative Bangla typing stats, unlocked keys, and settings.

/users/{userId}/lessons/{lessonId}.description: Owner-only subcollection of completed typing lesson records.
